summary: plan.md now carries two phases — PA gates Jenkinsfile.iac-image on the image's input set as verified from the Dockerfile this pass (the provider is off the list: terraform.rc resolves through the tfmirror.home network mirror, no filesystem-mirror bake), and PB moves the IaCAgent tree to support/iac-agent/ with its history intact and repoints iac_agent_local_checkout, leaving the host layout, both --limit exclusions and the sibling-checkout fallback alone. verification.json holds 16 outcome-level criteria covering R1-R7 and N1/N4/N5 with file:line evidence; no attachments were needed. The seeded requirements/rulings text is unchanged except that its three `###` sub-headings were demoted to `####` — run_loop.py reserves `###` for phase headings and refused to parse the plan otherwise; `--dry-run` now resolves both targets (root, ansible).
